evidence.excerpt: Compared with command-granular exclusivity baselines, KREX delivers up to $3.4\times$ the benchmarking throughput with a negligible p95 timing inflation of $0.30\%$, $1.58\%$, and $3.90\%$ for kernels longer than 10 ms, 1 ms, and 0.1 ms, respectively.
